scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/worker build && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/web build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.stack:smoke: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/worker exec node scripts/stack-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && node scripts/prepare-e2e.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @novel-brain/api build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts
